# Spidy Sells

> Spidy Sells offers tiramisu and dessert ordering for customers in Kolkata and Howrah, West Bengal, India.

## Public pages
- [Home](https://spidy-sells.vercel.app/): Choose a service location and view current ordering options.
- [Menu](https://spidy-sells.vercel.app/menu): Browse currently published desserts and prices when the storefront is available.

## Important notes
- Menu items, prices, branch availability, and delivery options can change.
- Orders are not confirmed until the storefront completes its order flow.
- Use the website for the latest available information.

## Crawl guidance
- Sitemap: https://spidy-sells.vercel.app/sitemap.xml
- Robots policy: https://spidy-sells.vercel.app/robots.txt
